subject: hi-p
title: EXP.DY.------HI.P.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 99 (CS-27). HI-P (high purpose) is the subject; EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: FUND-DYM (fundamental dynamics), UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)) and SOC-RT (social reality); FUND-DYM carries the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From FUND-DYM: TRS (transition). From TRS: SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars). From SOC-RT-P: MOT-DY. From UNF-PI: EXB-H-OR (establishing high order). From EXB-H-OR: SPT-DT. From SOC-RT: C-INFO (composite information). From C-INFO: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism).
